title: Simulate usage-limit pause
description:
## Issue Setup

- UAT Required: No

## Issue Goal

Exercise usage-limit pause handling in a fixture workflow.

## Why Now

The runtime must pause safely when a backend reports a usage limit.

## Issue Context

This fixture is used by `examples/usage-limit-workflow.md`.

## Non-Negotiable Guardrails

- Do not advance to Agent Review when the backend reports a usage limit.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Fixture-only backend failure.

## Canonical References

### Target Repository / Package

- Alive24/jade-symphony

### Relevant Knowledge Sources

- docs/dogfood-readiness.md

### Relevant Code Paths

- src/agent.rs
- src/main.rs
- src/runtime_state.rs

## Current State

Usage-limit handling is being verified in a memory tracker workflow.

## Deliverable Shape

A safe pause with runtime retry evidence.

## Risks or Constraints

- This fixture must not call external agent services.

## Expected Outcome

The run-loop records a usage-limit pause and stops without moving to Agent Review.

## Verification

### Completion Criteria

- Runtime retry state is written.

### Functional Verification

- `cargo test`

### UAT

- Run the usage-limit fixture workflow.

### Context Verification

- Confirm tracker state does not advance to Agent Review.
